name: slidecraft-editable
description: Design slides and image assets, then build verified editable PowerPoint presentations.

publication.release_notes: Clarify presentation productivity use cases and package the editable-slide workflow using the supported Codex compatibility format.

interface.longDescription: SlideCraft helps people create and revise PowerPoint presentations for work, study and personal projects. Turn an informal brief into a slide, continue the design of an uploaded deck, or develop a new visual concept. Text is built as editable text boxes; supported tables, charts and diagrams remain editable objects. Photographs, illustrations and backgrounds are images. Proofread slide text and check layout before delivery. Request slides in your preferred language and include your own optional branding. Requires ChatGPT Work or Codex with PowerPoint file-authoring libraries; image generation requires image tools available in your account. Pixel-perfect matching and identical rendering on every device are not guaranteed.
defaultPrompt: Use SlideCraft to design a polished slide, generate its artwork, and build an editable PowerPoint.
Use SlideCraft to make the next editable slide in the style of my attached presentation.
